definitions.title: Plan Bay Area 2050+: Final Regional Growth Forecast
definitions.publisher: Metropolitan Transportation Commission / Association of Bay Area Governments
definitions.licence: Agency public meeting attachment. Retain its original attribution and source document; no additional reuse licence is asserted.
definitions.notes: Original December 17, 2024 meeting attachment, two pages. Table 1 on page 2 contains four regional series and seven labelled years (2020–2050). It is the published 2050+ forecast background, not an issued 2060 procurement specification. Source notes a 2023 plan base year although the table begins 2020. All nine counties are covered as one aggregate; this table does not supply county allocations. Historical/forecast roles are preserved as published; no blanket assertion that 2020 or 2025 is an observed actual. Original retained PDF: 152,937 bytes.

Subsequent issued editions use the existing source review and issue controls after inspecting the actual received documents.
